checks.title: Stats drift (stored normalization stats vs actual data)
checks.summary: data matches the sample's bootstrap interval and stored range (worst 0% of the FAIL threshold)

findings.message: sampled subset and no per-episode stats: mean/std checked against the bootstrap sampling distribution of the loaded episodes, plus range containment (a full load is the conclusive audit)

checks.title: Timestamp grid (spacing, monotonic, start at 0)
checks.summary: evenly spaced at 10 fps and monotonic

checks.title: Dropped / duplicated frames
checks.summary: frame_index contiguous; episode lengths and video segments match the data

checks.title: Calibration drift (action vs state on still frames)
checks.skip_reason: state dim 8 != action dim 7 and no names to pair them by

checks.title: Idle segments (policy learns to do nothing)
checks.summary: no episode starts idle or idles >= 30%

checks.title: Stuck actuators (joints that never move)
checks.summary: every joint moves wherever the dataset uses it

findings.message: joint 6 does not move in 7/174 episodes [425, 496, 497, 561, 685, 687, 744] - it moves in the others - dead or disabled motor during those recordings? [dim looks like an unnamed gripper]

checks.title: Action saturation (commands clipped at the limits)
checks.summary: no continuous action dim pinned at a limit above 5% (6 dims checked)

checks.title: NaN / Inf and normalization hazards
checks.summary: no NaN/Inf; all dims have usable variance

checks.title: Duplicate episodes / train-eval leakage
checks.summary: no exact, partial or near duplicates

checks.title: Outlier episodes (duration, jerk, velocity, static, end-pose)

findings.message: episode 1509: IQR outlier on velocity_spike, end_pose_deviation
